description: This file defines Marathi (India) culture information for the DateJS library, including localized names for days, months, date formats, regex patterns for parsing dates in Marathi, and date manipulation functions.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time part of a Date object to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the current date with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of a day name in the culture's day names.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of a month name in the culture's month names.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a specific year.
